inputs.body:
Hello, I hope the office is well. I wanted to write rather than call because I never know who is picking up. My husband and I have used you for about six years, ever since the Peterson job next door, and generally we have been happy, which is why I am a bit sad to be writing at all.

Last Tuesday the young man who came out for the bathroom sink was very polite and did good work, I will say that. But he tracked something onto the hallway carpet, I think it was flux or grease, and there is a dark patch now that wasn't there before. I did not say anything at the time because I was on the phone with my sister, who has been unwell, and by the time I noticed he had gone. I am not asking for anything dramatic. My husband thinks I should just buy a cleaner but I thought you ought to know. Also the invoice says two hours and I thought it was closer to one and a half, though I could be wrong, I was not timing it.

Anyway. Thank you for reading this long note. Please pass on my regards to Marisol.

Evelyn Hargrove
7 Quarry Road
